tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0102, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0103 1. Lemma 3.27\group harmonic-map-flow

The DeTurck diffeomorphisms $\varphi _t$ solving $\partial _t\varphi _t=-W\circ \varphi _t$ satisfy the harmonic map heat flow with domain metric $\bar g(t)$ and codomain metric $\tilde g$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0102, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0103 \sketch Substitute the DeTurck vector field into the harmonic map Laplacian formula and identify the resulting evolution equation with $\partial _t\varphi _t$.

□
